title: Render JSON data
summary: Ruby on Rails: Render JSON data. Add an author field.
introduction: render json turns a Ruby value into a JSON response. Open GET /book.
learningObjectives: Render JSON data with Ruby on Rails

blocks.text: Create a practice project with rails new school --api --skip-active-record. Enter it. Put each labelled section into its named file, then run bin/rails server -b 127.0.0.1 -p 8000. No database is needed.

blocks.title: Render JSON data
blocks.code:
# config/routes.rb
Rails.application.routes.draw do
get "/book", to: "lesson#book"
end

# app/controllers/lesson_controller.rb
class LessonController < ActionController::API
def book
 render json: { title: "Moon Trip", pages: 24 }
end
end

blocks.text: The action passes a Ruby hash to render json, which serialises its named fields.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Do not call render twice in one action.
